title: Derive clear requirements and system definitions with canonical guidance
actor: An engineer new to REM or an engineering agent assisting that engineer
goal: Produce and explain a coherent draft need, its obligations, stakeholder situations, and logical capability definitions from prepared project context.
context: The participant knows basic engineering practice but needs REM-specific guidance without the originating conversation.
trigger: The participant begins analysis of a supplied stakeholder need.
preconditions: The need, selected project profile, and available authoring formats are identifiable.

interaction.action: Requests guidance for deriving requirements and explaining their associated capabilities and stakeholder situations.
Presents the applicable canonical methods, rules, source versions, and worked examples.
Provides draft definitions and identifies any uncertainty encountered.
Explains the applicable semantic distinctions and correction steps, identifying unsupported conclusions and the highest-value clarification when necessary.

expected_outcome: The author can produce and explain seven-part requirement analysis, single-parent derivation, black-box situations, and distinct Feature/Function definitions within the supported profile.

alternatives.condition: The author is an experienced reviewer or an agent.
alternatives.outcome: The system provides the same governing meaning and source versions in guidance suited to that participant.

failures.condition: Essential need context or an applicable method is unavailable.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the gap and leaves dependent analysis provisional rather than inventing a requirement.

failures.condition: A desired record format is undeclared.
failures.outcome: The system explains the conceptual activity and support limit without claiming a conformant record.

sources.basis: Analyzes IR-006 through a distinct stakeholder goal within the selected initial authoring profile; the owning IR records Scenario ownership. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage. This confirms analysis only, not requirement approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
